plot: On race morning the Golden Race Trophy vanishes; Bolt uses Grumpy's shiny-thing sneeze as a detector while Turbo and Bertha (flat roof) prove honest at the press, then the sneeze points to little Pip, who only wanted to know how holding a trophy feels because Turbo teased her for always coming last; Turbo apologises, Pip runs her best race ever (lesson: trying your best is the real prize), then wobbly wide tracks cross the finish line.

script.title: Who Took the Race Trophy? 🏆🤧 Follow the Sneeze!
script.description: It's race morning, and the Golden Race Trophy vanishes from the podium! Grumpy sneezes near shiny things, so Inspector Bolt turns his nose into a detector while Turbo and Bertha take the Truth Press. Trying your best is the real prize. Inspector Bolt #7

set.place: Wheelburg race starting line, race morning

beats.say: Vroom, vroom, VROOM! Race morning! Engines roared as everyone zoomed to the starting line!
Make way! The champion has arrived! That's me, in case you were wondering.
This year I'm racing too! I practised every single day!
You? Pip, you're tiny. You always finish last. Like, really, really last.
Last is still finishing! And this year I'll be faster. You'll see.
Turbo, be nice. Everyone can race. That's the rule of the Big Race.
On the podium shone the prize. The Golden Race Trophy, sparkling in the sun.
Ah... ah... AH-CHOO! Too shiny. Shiny things make me sneeze.
Bless you, Grumpy! Maybe park a little farther away from it.
I'm only here to tow anyone who breaks down. Not to look at that thing.
Everybody lined up and revved their engines. Three, two...
My trophy! I mean... the trophy! Somebody stole the prize!
No trophy means no race! Oh, this is terrible!
Can't we still race without a trophy?
Race for nothing? Nobody races for nothing, Pip!
Honk honk! Inspector Bolt rolled up to the starting line.
Good morning. I hear a very shiny trophy has gone missing.
Grumpy, you sneeze near shiny things. When did you last sneeze?
Right before it vanished. Since then, nothing. My nose is very quiet.
Interesting. Then wherever the trophy is hiding, Grumpy's nose will find it.
A sneezing tow truck detector? That's the weirdest plan ever!
Weird plans are often the best ones. But first, the Truth Press.
Turbo, you wanted that trophy most of all. Please go first.
Fine! But only because I have nothing to hide. Squeeze away!
Turbo, did you take the Golden Race Trophy?
No! I want to win it, not take it! Winning is my favourite thing!
Squeeze! Turbo's eyes stayed small. He was telling the truth.
Honest. Grumpy, please drive past Turbo. Any sneeze?
Sniff, sniff. Nothing. He just smells like a show-off.
Hey! Show-off is a very nice smell!
Big Bertha, you're next.
Me? I carry children, not trophies! There isn't room for both!
Bertha, did you take the trophy?
No, no, no. I'm the one who said everybody can race!
The press squeezed so hard that Bertha's roof went flat as a pancake.
Oh! My roof! Well, at least I'm honest. Flat, but honest!
Small eyes. Grumpy, any sneeze near Bertha?
Sniff. Nothing. Just crayons and lunchboxes.
That's because the kids leave them everywhere!
Two honest cars. No trophy. And the race was about to start.
Grumpy, please drive slowly around the whole starting line. Let your nose lead the way.
So Grumpy rolled past every car. Sniff... sniff... sniff...
Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOOO!

beats.text: THE SNEEZE IS NEXT TO PIP!

beats.say: Pip? Tiny Pip? No way!
Maybe Grumpy just has a cold?
Pip, your eyes are very big. And that was not a cold sneeze.
Then, plonk! The Golden Race Trophy rolled out from behind Pip.
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I wasn't going to keep it. I promise.
Pip, sweetie, why did you take it?
I always come last. I just wanted to know how it feels to hold a trophy.
Only for one minute. Then I got scared to put it back.
Because I said you always finish last. Oh. That wasn't nice of me.
Pip, taking the trophy was not okay. It belongs to the race.
I know. I'll put it back right now.
Thank you. Now tell me. Do you practise every day?
Every single day. Even in the rain.
Then you already have something no trophy can give. You never give up.
Pip, I'm sorry I teased you. Racing with you is fun. Even if you're slow.
Thanks, Turbo! And maybe today I won't be quite so slow!
Winning is nice. But trying your very best is the real prize.
And the Big Race began! Turbo zoomed ahead, and Pip pushed with all her might.
Go, Pip, go! You can do it!
Go, tiny car. Go. I'm not cheering. I'm just saying go.
Pip didn't win. But she finished faster than ever before. Her best time ever!
I did it! My fastest race ever! That feels even better than a trophy!
Pip, you were amazing! Here. You can hold it for one happy minute.
Ah... ah... AH-CHOO! Too much shiny. Too much happy.
Another case cracked. Do your best, Wheelburg. That is how every car shines.
Everybody cheered. But wait... who left these wobbly tracks across the finish line?
Hmm. Very wide tracks. And very wobbly. Most mysterious.
Who made the wobbly tracks? Inspector Bolt will find out. Stay tuned!
